title: MLReasoningResult
description: Output produced by the ML Brain module. Consumed by downstream response/orchestration systems.

alert_id.description: Echo of the input alert_id for traceability.

processed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the ML module processed this alert.

model_version.description: Identifier of the fine-tuned model that produced this output.

attack_type_confirmed.description: Model's confirmed classification. May differ from pipeline's initial detection.

mitre_techniques.description: List of MITRE ATT&CK techniques this attack maps to.

confidence.description: Model confidence in its classification and recommendation. 0.0 = no confidence, 1.0 = certain.

severity_assessment.description: Model's own severity assessment, informed by context and propagation risk.

reasoning.description: Step-by-step reasoning chain produced by the model explaining WHY this classification was made.

recommended_action.description: Concrete defensive action the system should take.

justification.description: One to three sentences justifying the recommended_action in plain English.

affected_services.description: List of microservices that are currently or potentially affected.

propagation_risk.description: Estimated risk that this attack can spread to other services if not contained.
